facts.fact: Will 只当了几个月 Dauntless、体力不够，Four 一下就在两人之间拉开一整条街。
facts.anchor: Will has only been Dauntless for a couple months, so his physical stamina isn’t quite what it could be

facts.fact: 电梯门关上的一刻，他看见 Peter 正朝大楼入口走来。
facts.anchor: as the elevator doors close, I see Peter marching toward the entrance

facts.fact: 让他一惊的是 Andrew Prior 像 Tris：不是棕色的眼睛，而是倔强的嘴形和又长又瘦的脸。
facts.anchor: What startles me is that he looks like Tris

facts.fact: 门开时他单手接住门、往前一推，正撞在 Peter 的肩上，Peter 踉跄进玄关角落。
facts.anchor: I catch it in one hand and shove it forward so it hits Peter hard in the shoulder

facts.fact: 打 Peter 本该更痛快，可 Peter 眼里没有认出他的神色，只有疼。
facts.anchor: there’s no recognition in his eyes, only pain

facts.fact: Andrew 没把 Marcus 称作「我父亲」，因为他选 Dauntless 那天就被断绝了关系。
facts.anchor: Probably because he disowned me the day I chose Dauntless

facts.fact: 他朝黑影开枪、刻意瞄低，打中的是 Marlene 的腿。
facts.anchor: I hit Marlene in the leg

facts.fact: 教堂门口脚步逼近，他举枪对准门，出现的是 Tris。
facts.anchor: a flash of gold hair, and bright blue eyes, wet with tears
